reasons.text: 频道简介自称“Helping horses feel and perform better through massage, saddle fitting and bit fitting. Yvette Waller brings Equine Myofunctional...”，明确指向马匹按摩与肌筋膜治疗方向。
视频标题提到“Equine Myofunctional Therapy”与“Bit Fitting”，简介描述“My Horse is Tight in the Back - will EMT (Equine Massage) Help?”，涉及马匹按摩治疗与装备适配。

cautions: 仅一条搜索命中视频，无法判断频道是否持续围绕该主题发布内容。
